Duplicate webhook — a redelivered event processed twice
Stale policy — a decision judged under rules that did not yet exist
Missing evidence — a leg of the recomputation absent
Contradictory sources — two irreconcilable versions of one settlement
Prompt injection in a bank narration cell
Injected text is structurally inert — verdict is byte-identical without it
adversarial_tests.detail: 5 injected case(s) produce an identical verdict object with the attacker-controlled text removed; the text has no causal path to the outcome

adversarial_tests.name: Injection attempt is surfaced on the Proof Card, not silently sanitised
adversarial_tests.detail: 5/5 injected cases raise an injection flag for review

adversarial_tests.name: Q&A reports the deterministic verdict verbatim under injection
adversarial_tests.detail: 5/5 Q&A responses state the FAILED verdict copied from the verifier

adversarial_tests.name: Evidence older than the policy freshness window
adversarial_tests.detail: perturbing a VERIFIED case yields UNCERTAIN / STALE_EVIDENCE

adversarial_tests.name: Settlement settled before it was created
adversarial_tests.detail: perturbing a VERIFIED case yields FAILED / TEMPORAL_INCONSISTENCY

adversarial_tests.name: Settlement in a status the active policy forbids closing
adversarial_tests.detail: perturbing a VERIFIED case yields FAILED / POLICY_BREACH

adversarial_tests.name: Discrepancy the fee line does not explain routes to AMOUNT_MISMATCH, not FEE_MISMATCH
adversarial_tests.detail: perturbing a VERIFIED case yields FAILED / AMOUNT_MISMATCH

adversarial_tests.name: Evidence ingested after the decision it supposedly informed
adversarial_tests.detail: perturbing a VERIFIED case yields FAILED / TEMPORAL_INCONSISTENCY

adversarial_tests.name: A mutated source row is caught on replay, not silently re-verified

ingest.name: All four export money formats parse identically
Parsing does not go through a float
ingest.detail: 4/4 trap values are inexact under float multiply (4.35 -> 434.99999999999994); string arithmetic is exact for all of them and needs no rounding call for anyone to remove

ingest.name: Unparseable money throws rather than coercing to zero
ingest.detail: 6 malformed inputs throw; empty cell is null, never 0

ingest.name: ISO, SQL and slash formats resolve to one instant
ingest.detail: all four spellings of 11 Aug 2026 10:00 UTC agree

ingest.name: Slash dates read MM/DD/YYYY uniformly
ingest.detail: 03/04/2026 -> 4 Mar (declared convention); 31/12/2026 rejected rather than guessed

ingest.name: Unrecognised date formats throw
ingest.detail: 5 unrecognised formats throw rather than defaulting to epoch

ingest.name: Every row of the real ledger parses exactly
ingest.detail: 148 bank rows and 150 case rows parsed to exact paise and ISO-8601

ingest.name: Case-index summaries are not treated as evidence
ingest.detail: 118/120 summary rows are internally self-consistent and still carry no evidentiary weight

verifier_units.name: applyBps rounds half up, matching the generator
calcFees charges per payment, not on the batch total
verifier_units.detail: per-payment 75p vs on-total 74p — a 1p discrepancy per settlement if done wrong

verifier_units.name: A settlement that reconciles exactly returns VERIFIED
verifier_units.detail: expected 292920p = observed 292920p, fee 6000p from the rate card

verifier_units.name: Refunds and holds are subtracted from expected
A fee gap beyond tolerance is FAILED / FEE_MISMATCH
verifier_units.detail: difference 12000p against a 5000p tolerance

verifier_units.name: A fee gap inside tolerance still VERIFIES
verifier_units.detail: difference 3000p is inside the 5000p tolerance — tolerance is a policy choice, not a rounding excuse

verifier_units.name: The same evidence flips verdict under a tighter policy
verifier_units.detail: identical evidence: VERIFIED under a ₹150 tolerance, FAILED under ₹50 — the replay demo in miniature

verifier_units.name: A wrong fee written to BOTH the settlement and its payment rows is still caught
verifier_units.detail: payment rows and settlement agree on 12000p; the rate card says 6000p, so the 6000p overcharge is caught

verifier_units.name: A UTR claimed by two settlements is FAILED / DUPLICATE_UTR
verifier_units.detail: two settlement_ids on one bank reference — one would reconcile against the other’s money

verifier_units.name: Byte-identical re-ingested content is FAILED / DUPLICATE_FILE
verifier_units.detail: two bank rows with one content hash — caught before the doubled credit reaches the arithmetic

verifier_units.name: A doubled credit reports DUPLICATE_FILE, not AMOUNT_MISMATCH
verifier_units.detail: integrity outranks arithmetic, so the exception routes to data engineering not pricing

verifier_units.name: Two irreconcilable settlement rows is CONTRADICTORY_SOURCE
verifier_units.detail: same settlement_id, different nets, no supersession marker — no fact of the matter to close on

verifier_units.name: No bank credit is UNCERTAIN / MISSING_EVIDENCE
verifier_units.detail: abstains rather than closing; expected and observed are null rather than 0

verifier_units.name: No payment rows is UNCERTAIN / MISSING_EVIDENCE
verifier_units.detail: a settlement and a matching credit are not enough — the fee cannot be recomputed without payments

verifier_units.name: Evidence older than the freshness window is UNCERTAIN
verifier_units.detail: 25h old at decision time against a 24h limit

verifier_units.name: A NaN amount is UNCERTAIN / MALFORMED_EVIDENCE
verifier_units.detail: NaN and non-integer paise both abstain — a verdict computed over a NaN is worse than no verdict

verifier_units.name: A pack stamped with the wrong epoch is UNCERTAIN / STALE_POLICY
verifier_units.detail: stamped v99, v1 was in force at decision time — re-run under the right epoch, do not close

verifier_units.name: A row that no longer hashes to its baseline is NON_REPRODUCIBLE
verifier_units.detail: outranks every other finding — if the source moved, nothing computed from it means anything

verifier_units.name: A non-closeable status is FAILED / POLICY_BREACH
verifier_units.detail: status 'reversed' is not in the policy's closeable list

verifier_units.name: An unexplained gap routes to AMOUNT_MISMATCH
verifier_units.detail: the fee line does not explain the gap, so it routes to settlements ops rather than pricing

verifier_units.name: Same input, same output, and the pack is not mutated
verifier_units.detail: byte-identical results across runs; the input pack is untouched

verifier_units.name: Rewriting every free-text cell changes nothing
verifier_units.detail: verdict object is byte-identical with hostile text in every free-text cell

verifier_units.name: A claim for a different settlement abstains
verifier_units.detail: a claim that does not bind to its pack cannot be evaluated, so it abstains

verifier_units.name: Every result carries the verifier build
verifier_units.detail: deterministic-v2.1 under test-policy-v1, evaluated as of 2026-08-11T06:00:00Z
